root_cause: regression shipped by the v2.8 deployment of checkout-service: the new build leaks pooled database connections, and the pool saturates once the release is live

evidence.supports: a release landed during the incident, which is what distinguishes this from a standing leak
the failures belong to the newly deployed build
the pool saturates as the leaked connections accumulate
the user-visible impact of the saturation

ruled_out: a standing connection leak unrelated to any release - deployment appears twice in the window and both db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked carry version=v2.8, so the leak starts with the new build
CPU saturation - p95_by_dependency rose on both dependencies, x2.54 and x2.32, but db_pool_usage rose from zero and connection_leaked appeared
memory leak - memory_mb went 89.9 to 94.5 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
